components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Red fill CTA for create and confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #DC4C3E; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px Public Sans, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c44134; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #DC4C3E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #202020; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px Public Sans, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F5F5F5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #DC4C3E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Task Check
components.css: .ds-task-check { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid #b8b8b8; background: #fff; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-task-check:hover { border-color: #DC4C3E; background: rgba(220,76,62,0.1); } .ds-task-check[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #DC4C3E; border-color: #DC4C3E; } .ds-task-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(220,76,62,0.3); }

components.name: Add Task
components.description: Red text row that opens the composer.
components.css: .ds-add-task { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #DC4C3E; background: transparent; border: none; font: 400 14px Public Sans, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-add-task:hover { background: rgba(220,76,62,0.05); } .ds-add-task-plus { width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 9999px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 0 8px; border: none; background: transparent; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 13px Public Sans, sans-serif; color: #202020; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(236,236,236,0.7); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #ececec; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-count { margin-left: auto; font-size: 12px; color: #5c5c5c; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #dddddd; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 10px; font: 400 14px Public Sans, sans-serif; color: #202020; background: #fff; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid rgba(220,76,62,0.3); border-color: #DC4C3E; }

narrative.overview: CocheCoche s'habille comme une liste Todoist : papier blanc, rail gris pâle, rouge unique pour l'action et le logo. La densité est celle d'un outil quotidien, pas d'une landing marketing. Pas de tickets perforés, pas de forêt sombre, pas d'eyebrow.
keyCharacteristics: Listes plates à filets 1px, jamais de cartes-tâches
Sidebar 280px, Aujourd'hui comme vue par défaut

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Le rouge ne décore pas. Il coche, il ajoute, il signale le retard.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Pas de Syne, pas de mono costume. Le mono reste pour les préfixes de clé API.

dos: Colorer les dates (rouge / vert) plutôt que des badges
Garder le logo au rouge primaire, coche blanche
donts: Ajouter un eyebrow au-dessus d'un titre
